question: Pillared Verandah and cells are integral parts of which of the following Buddhist structures?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajanta Caves**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pillared verandahs and cells are integral parts of the Ajanta Caves ** Buddhist structures
 
• **Ajanta Caves**
 
 
• The **Ajanta Caves include a vihara**, which is a Buddhist structure that typically has a pillared verandah, cells, a hall, and a garbha griha.
 
• For example,** Cave 20 has a pillared verandah with two stone-cut windows, four cells for monks, and a sanctu**m.
 
• The **interior of the cave also has a large Buddha shrine at the back**
 
• Viharas are usually small, simple rooms that are used for meditation and sleeping.
 
• They may be located in a larger complex that includes other buildings for communal activities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tawang Monastery**

 
 
• It is** Located in the Himalayas of Arunachal Pradesh**, this is India's largest monastery and the second largest in the world.
 
• It **was established in the 17th century and is a center for Mahayana Buddhis**m.
 
• The monastery complex includes **a library, a three-story main assembly hall, and residential quarters for monks. **
 
 
 
• **Bodhgaya Temple**
 
 
• It is **Located in the town of Bodh Gaya, Bihar,** this t**emple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• It is **considered a significant place for Buddhists because it is where Buddha gained enlightenment. **
 
 
 
• **Sanchi Stupa**
 
 
• It is** Located in Sanchi, Madhya Pradesh, this stupa was built in the 3rd century BC** by the Mauryan King Ashoka.
 
• It was built to enshrine Buddha's relics and symbolize the Buddhist faith.
 
• The** stupa is a hemispherical structure with a chhatra (parasol) on top, **which symbolizes high rank.
